def evolved_alltoallv(input_tensor, send_counts, recv_counts, max_chunk,
                      rank, world_size, num_devices, cores_per_device,
                      xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """Reduce-scatter based all-to-all-v.
    Build [dst][src] table; only local rank's src slots are filled.
    Reduce-scatter (sum) over dst shards yields, for our rank r,
    the [src] data addressed to us. Then per-source slice + cat."""
    pack = world_size * max_chunk
    full = torch.zeros(world_size * pack, device=input_tensor.device, dtype=input_tensor.dtype)
    send_off = 0
    for i in range(world_size):
        sc = send_counts[i]
        if sc > 0:
            base = i * pack + rank * max_chunk
            full[base:base + sc] = input_tensor[send_off:send_off + sc]
        send_off += sc
    recvd = xm.reduce_scatter(xm.REDUCE_SUM, full, 1.0, 0, world_size)
    chunks = []
    for src in range(world_size):
        count = recv_counts[src]
        base = src * max_chunk
        chunks.append(recvd[base:base + count])
    return torch.cat(chunks)

def evolved_alltoallv(input_tensor, send_counts, recv_counts, max_chunk,
                      rank, world_size, num_devices, cores_per_device,
                      xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """Ring all-to-all via collective_permute: step k sends chunk for
    dst=(r+k)%ws and receives chunk from src=(r-k)%ws. Only max_chunk
    moved per step."""
    send_pad = torch.zeros(world_size * max_chunk, device=input_tensor.device, dtype=input_tensor.dtype)
    send_off = 0
    for i in range(world_size):
        sc = send_counts[i]
        if sc > 0:
            send_pad[i * max_chunk:i * max_chunk + sc] = input_tensor[send_off:send_off + sc]
        send_off += sc
    send_pad = send_pad.view(world_size, max_chunk)
    out = [None] * world_size
    # self
    out[rank] = send_pad[rank][:recv_counts[rank]]
    for k in range(1, world_size):
        dst = (rank + k) % world_size
        src = (rank - k) % world_size
        pairs = [[j, (j + k) % world_size] for j in range(world_size)]
        received = xm.collective_permute(send_pad[dst], pairs)
        out[src] = received[:recv_counts[src]]
    return torch.cat(out)

def evolved_alltoallv(input_tensor, send_counts, recv_counts, max_chunk,
                      rank, world_size, num_devices, cores_per_device,
                      xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """Bruck (log-step) all-to-all-v. Pad blocks to max_chunk, do
    ceil(log2(P)) collective_permute rounds, then per-source slice."""
    P = world_size
    m = max_chunk
    dev = input_tensor.device
    dt = input_tensor.dtype
    send_pad = torch.zeros(P * m, device=dev, dtype=dt)
    off = 0
    for i in range(P):
        sc = send_counts[i]
        if sc > 0:
            send_pad[i * m:i * m + sc] = input_tensor[off:off + sc]
        off += sc

    recv = send_pad.index_select(0, (rank + ar) % P)
    k = 1
    while k < P:
        sel = [j for j in range(P) if (j & k)]
        sel_t = torch.tensor(sel, device=dev)
        pack = recv.index_select(0, sel_t).reshape(-1)
        pairs = [[j, (j - k) % P] for j in range(P)]
        got = xm.collective_permute(pack, pairs).view(len(sel), m)
        recv = recv.index_copy(0, sel_t, got)
        k <<= 1
    # inverse rotation: result[j] = recv[(rank - j) % P]  (source j)
    result = recv.index_select(0, (rank - ar) % P)
    chunks = []
    for src in range(P):
        chunks.append(result[src][:recv_counts[src]])
    return torch.cat(chunks)
